rules: Build dataset clients with createDatasetClient({ queryBuilder }) from @hypequery/datasets, passing a builder from createQueryBuilder in @hypequery/clickhouse. The createBackend / plan-backend path is deprecated and frozen; do not use it in new code.
Pass the tenant from trusted server-side context (runtime: { tenant }), never from request input. Datasets with a tenantKey reject queries without one.

Scaffold datasets from the live ClickHouse schema (TypeScript: npx hypequery generate:datasets; Python: hypequery generate datasets), then rename fields to product language, remove meaningless measures and add descriptions.
ReplacingMergeTree and CollapsingMergeTree sources need row resolution (FINAL) or measures double count.
Measure values can be returned as strings to keep decimals exact; convert them before doing arithmetic.

When querying through hypequery MCP tools, do not write SQL: call list_datasets, then get_dataset_schema, then query_dataset or query_metric with the dimensions, measures and filters the schema lists.
